Overview As SOC Team Leader within the Smart Operations Centre (SOC), you will lead real-time operational activities during your assigned shift, ensuring incidents are detected, validated, escalated, and driven to restoration in accordance with operational procedures and SLA commitments. You will provide operational leadership to SOC Monitors, coordinating incident response, maintaining shift continuity, and ensuring high standards of execution, documentation, and communication throughout the incident lifecycle. Supervising SOC Monitors by ensuring consistent alarm handling, ticket and work order creation, escalation discipline, documentation quality, and providing coaching to strengthen operational performance. Monitoring incident-level SLA timers and validating escalation thresholds to ensure response and restoration activities are initiated within agreed service commitments while filtering false-positive alarms. Coordinating restoration activities with Maintenance Partners, the Energy Desk, and operational support teams to ensure incidents progress efficiently to resolution, escalating delays, recurring failures, and complex technical issues to Optimization Engineers (L3) and the SOC Manager where appropriate. Managing structured shift handovers by ensuring open incidents, operational risks, pending actions, SLA-critical events, and ownership responsibilities are clearly documented and effectively transferred between shifts. Maintaining accurate operational dashboards, incident logs, and real-time reporting to provide clear operational visibility and support informed decision-making throughout the shift. Applying the operational escalation matrix consistently during major incidents and service-impacting events, ensuring escalations are timely, factual, and aligned with established operational procedures. Coordinating site access requests during non-office hours by validating approvals, maintaining complete access records, and ensuring all activities remain fully traceable. Serving as the operational point of contact for Mobile Network Operator (MNO) NOCs during assigned shifts by communicating factual incident status updates while directing SLA discussions and customer governance matters to the CSOC team. Ensuring complete and accurate ICCP and WFM documentation for incidents, operational tasks, escalation activities, and incident closure records. Strong understanding of incident management processes, alarm management, escalation procedures, and SLA-driven operations. Experience using operational monitoring platforms such as ICCP, WFM, NMS, RMS, or equivalent operational systems. Proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders during operational incidents while maintaining service continuity. Experience working within telecommunications, tower infrastructure, utilities, or mission-critical operational environments. Strong organisational and shift coordination capability. Sound understanding of SLA management and operational governance. Digital proficiency with ICCP, WFM, operational dashboards, and monitoring platforms. Key Deliverables Correctly validated, prioritised, and escalated incidents managed through to restoration. Accurate alarm correlation, incident tracking, and SLA monitoring records. Complete and structured shift handover documentation with clear ownership and follow-up actions. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies. In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction. UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results. Job Purpose Under the guidance of a Regional Director, you will lead a Country team in the development and management of an innovative Country Programme of Cooperation focused on population and development and universal access to sexual and reproductive health and rights, including maternal health, family planning, gender, and adolescent and youth empowerment. You are accountable for the effective implementation of the Country Programme, playing the lead role in promoting the mandate of the organization, and ensuring the integration of issues of sexual and reproductive health and rights in the broader national development agenda. Through engagement with national counterparts, UN Country Teams, compelling advocacy, and delivery of effective programmes, including in emergency settings, you serve on the frontline of the organization, validating both the mandate of the organization and its ability to deliver high quality support and results. review_candidates.title: Helly Hansen is looking for an Executive Assistant
review_candidates.description: Founded in Norway in 1877, Helly Hansen continues to develop professional grade apparel that helps people stay and feel alive. Through insights drawn from living and working in the world’s harshest environments, the company has developed a long list of first-to-market innovations, including the first supple waterproof fabrics nearly 150 years ago. Other breakthroughs include the first fleece fabrics in the 1960s, the first technical base layers in the 1970s, made with LIFA® Stay Dry technology, the patented H2Flow™ temperature regulating system, and the revolutionary lighter, warmer LIFALOFT™ insulation. Building on Helly Hansen’s proprietary HELLY TECH® waterproof/breathable system, the technical outdoor brand has most recently introduced the award-winning LIFA INFINITY PRO™ - the company’s most innovative waterproof/breathable technology to date. Helly Hansen is a leader in technical sailing and performance ski apparel, as well as premium workwear. Its uniforms are worn and trusted by more than 55,000 professionals and can be found on Olympians, National Teams, and at more than 200 ski resorts and mountain guiding operations globally. Helly Hansen’s outerwear, base layers, sportswear and footwear are sold in more than 40 countries around the world. To learn more about Helly Hansen’s latest collections, visit www.hellyhansen.com. Helly Hansen is looking for an Executive Assistant to support our Leadership Team As Executive Assistant, you will support Helly Hansen’s Leadership Team (LT) with day-to-day coordination, planning, and follow-up. This is a varied role where you will need to stay one step ahead, think practically, and handle sensitive information with care. Your tasks will include: Manage calendars for members of the Leadership Team and help keep schedules running smoothly. Plan and coordinate travel, logistics, agendas, and presentation materials for onsite and offsite meetings and events. Manage and process travel and expense claims. Take care of a wide range of administrative tasks that help the Leadership Team lead the business effectively. Work closely with the LT to stay on top of upcoming commitments, priorities, and follow-ups. Help create a warm and welcoming experience for visitors, colleagues, and others who interact with the company in close collaboration with the Office team. Coordinate signatures for relevant documents, including electronic signature processes across the wider organization. Provide support for internal and external events and contribute to a variety of headquarters activities and initiatives. As the above mentioned tasks will vary over different periods, support on request varying from practical coordination around Helly Hansen’s commercial calendar and practical tasks in the office, as well as support with people processes and general management will be required. What We Are Looking For You are confident handling administrative work and enjoy keeping things organized. You pay close attention to the details. You have solid experience supporting senior leaders. You handle confidential information with good judgment and discretion. You make thoughtful decisions and use sound judgment. You are an expert at using Microsoft Office and savvy in digital tools. You communicate clearly, both in writing and in person. Fluency in Norwegian and English is required. You are comfortable working with many different people, from Board members and senior leaders to colleagues across the business and external contacts. You can handle several tasks and projects at once and know how to move things forward independently. You can respond quickly when needed and are comfortable changing direction when priorities shift. Work Environment You enjoy a busy, hands-on environment where you can take initiative. You work well with people from different teams and backgrounds. You are comfortable working with colleagues across different time zones. No task is too little, we all contribute to get the job done. The role reports to HR Director, EMEA Direct Reports: None We Offer A creative, international workplace with plenty going on. A team and culture that values great work and new ideas. Discounts on great gear. An active workplace with a real passion for sports and outdoors. No relocation support provided. This position is a full-time employment, based in our Oslo / HQ office (Norway). Questions can be directed to khorsle@hellyhansen.com Application (CV and cover letter) is ONLY accepted in the portal (due to personal data protection rules) and not later than 29 September 2026. We welcome early applications.
